[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Add `bob highlights create <md_file>` to bob-cli[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]highlights-create[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]highlights-create: add a Rust clap subcommand to the bob-cli highlights [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]group that converts a markdown file into a beautiful, TOC-indexed PDF [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]under ~/bob/lib/chat/ via a pandoc shell-out, embeds the page-1 /Text [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Highlights marker annotation with lopdf so `bob highlights scan` later [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]creates the Obsidian ref note, and ships polished colored [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]success/failure output, docs, and tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]file_hooks config section, matcher, and list CLI[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]hooks-config[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hooks-config: add the `file_hooks` section to the sase config schema and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]default config, a fail-soft typed loader mirroring mentor_profiles, a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wcmatch-based path matcher with negative-glob support, the `sase [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]file-hook list` command, docs, and unit tests. No commit-flow [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]integration yet.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Commit/artifact event capture, detached runner, notifications[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]hooks-engine[dim] · [dim][/dim]after hooks-config[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hooks-engine: capture per-file ADD/MODIFY/REMOVE events at both commit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]seams (CommitWorkflow and commit_sdd_files) and at `sase artifact [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]create`, match them against configured file_hooks, execute matched [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commands once per file in a detached batch runner (`sase file-hook [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exec-batch`), and send a sase notification per run with attached output;[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]never gate or slow the commit.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Configure the research-highlights hook and verify end to end[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]deploy-verify[dim] · [dim][/dim]after highlights-create, hooks-engine[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]deploy-verify: add the research-highlights file_hooks entry to the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]chezmoi-managed global sase.yml, apply it, install the new bob binary, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]run `bob highlights create` against the real 202607 beads research [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]report, verify the PDF and then the ref note produced by `bob highlights[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]scan`, and exercise the sase hook engine end to end including its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]notification.[/#D7D7AF]
